ADMIND_BASE_URL.description: admind's base URL the relay calls for workspace screens; defaults to http://127.0.0.1:18080

ADMIND_SOCKET_PATH.description: the admind Unix socket the relay calls for workspace screens; defaults to /run/internkim/admind.sock

ADMIN_ASSERTION_KEY_PATH.description: path to the key used to authenticate company-plane requests to Blueclaw

AGENT_API_KEY.description: the company agent key as a value, read only when AGENT_API_KEY_PATH is unset; for a shell driven by hand, never a deployment

AGENT_API_KEY_PATH.description: the path to the file holding the company agent key, so the key never lands in the process environment (ps eww)

ANSWER_BYTE_CEILING.description: maximum bytes the relay will broadcast through Supabase Realtime before answering 413; defaults to the Supabase Pro plan's 3,000,000-byte limit

ARRIVALS_PORT.description: the loopback port the relay listens on for the messenger connector's arrival notifications; defaults to 18091

BLUECLAW_ACP_SOCKET_PATH.description: the Unix socket blueclaw serves its ACP agent on, which the relay opens sessions over; defaults to /run/internkim/acp/blueclaw-acp.sock

BLUECLAW_BASE_URL.description: Blueclaw's base URL rendered into the company plane's runtime document; defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8080

BLUECLAW_BUILD_KERNEL.description: when "1", builds the guest Linux kernel from source instead of requiring BLUECLAW_KERNEL_IMAGE_SOURCE

BLUECLAW_BUN_VERSION.description: the Bun version installed into the Blueclaw guest rootfs; defaults to 1.3.10

BLUECLAW_E2E_LLM_PROVIDER.description: overrides the model provider internal/cli/test_command.go's scenario runner uses

BLUECLAW_KERNEL_IMAGE_SOURCE.description: a prebuilt arm64 guest kernel image to use instead of building one

BLUECLAW_LINUX_KERNEL_VERSION.description: the Linux kernel version built for the Blueclaw guest; defaults to 6.1.129

BLUECLAW_ROOTFS_IMAGE_SOURCE.description: a prebuilt guest rootfs image to use instead of building one

BLUECLAW_RUNTIME_ROOTFS_SIZE.description: the size of the Blueclaw guest rootfs ext4 image; defaults to 4G

BLUECLAW_UV_VERSION.description: the uv (Python package manager) version installed into the Blueclaw guest rootfs; defaults to 0.11.11

BUZZ_IMPORT_KEEP.description: when "1", keeps the imported rows after internal/buzzimport's live end-to-end test instead of cleaning up

BUZZ_IMPORT_KEEP_AUTHOR_SECRET.description: a Buzz author's signing secret used by internal/buzzimport/inject_visibility_test.go (a live/manual test)

BUZZ_IMPORT_KEEP_CHANNEL_ID.description: the Buzz channel ID internal/buzzimport/inject_visibility_test.go (a live/manual test) injects into

BUZZ_IMPORT_KEEP_DATABASE_URL.description: the Buzz relay database internal/buzzimport/inject_visibility_test.go (a live/manual test) connects to

BUZZ_IMPORT_TEST_AUTHOR_SECRET.description: a Buzz author's signing secret used by internal/buzzimport's live end-to-end and inject-probe tests

BUZZ_IMPORT_TEST_CHANNEL_ID.description: the Buzz channel ID internal/buzzimport's live end-to-end and inject-probe tests inject into

BUZZ_IMPORT_TEST_DATABASE_URL.description: the Buzz relay database internal/buzzimport's live end-to-end and inject-probe tests connect to

BUZZ_IMPORT_TEST_SECOND_AUTHOR_SECRET.description: a second Buzz author's signing secret used by internal/buzzimport/end_to_end_live_test.go (a live/manual test)

BUZZ_MEDIA_TEST_ACTOR_SECRET.description: the Buzz actor's signing secret used by internal/buzzimport/media's live upload test

BUZZ_MEDIA_TEST_HTTP_URL.description: the Buzz media HTTP base URL internal/buzzimport/media's live upload test uploads to

BUZZ_MEDIA_TEST_IMAGE.description: path to an image file internal/buzzimport/media's live upload test uploads; optional

CAPABILITY_SOCKET_PATH.description: the capabilityd Unix socket rendered into the company plane's runtime document; defaults to /run/internkim/capability.sock

CHATD_BASE_URL.description: chatd's base URL the relay calls; defaults to http://127.0.0.1:18090

CHATD_ENDPOINT.description: chatd's endpoint rendered into the company plane's runtime document; defaults to http://127.0.0.1:18090

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: the Cloudflare account ID for R2 release uploads and Pages deploys

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: a Cloudflare API token with Pages edit rights, used to provision an SSH Access service token and implicitly by Wrangler for Pages deploys

CLOUDFLARE_DOMAIN.description: the zone the web app treats as home when redirecting a company hostname, and the CLI's zone; falls back to the compiled-in default zone

CLOUD_HYPERVISOR_VERSION.description: the cloud-hypervisor version fetched for the Blueclaw guest runtime; defaults to 53.0

COMPANY_CONNECTIONS.description: the Durable Object namespace binding backing one company's gateway connections

COMPANY_PLANE_BIN.description: the shared-workspace directory containing Linux arm64 builds of capabilityd, admind, Blueclaw, the POSIX helper and the model stand-in, read by web/tests/plane/a-company-plane.ts

COMPANY_PLANE_DB_URL.description: the disposable PostgreSQL URL for the Local Fleet guest database, read by web/tests/plane/a-company-plane.ts to create and remove per-run state

COMPANY_PLANE_KEEP.description: when "1", web/tests/plane/a-company-plane.ts keeps the run directory after the test instead of deleting it

COMPANY_PLANE_SKILLS.description: the shared-workspace skills directory tools/prepare-company-plane assembles and hands to web/tests/plane for the sandboxed company plane

COMPANY_PLANE_STATE_ROOT.description: the VM-local temporary root where web/tests/plane/a-company-plane.ts keeps each run's state, secrets and logs

DATABASE_URL.description: the host's own Postgres connection string, which internkim install writes to the host's environment file; the host's prepare script refuses to run without it, and tools/render-company-runtime renders it into the runtime document

DEV.description: Vite's own build-mode flag (import.meta.env.DEV, true outside a production build), not a deployment setting

GATEWAY_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: the bearer token the web app's public-API gateway caller and the connection-gateway worker's admin endpoints share

GATEWAY_SERVER_KEY.description: the key the relay authenticates with when it connects out to the Cloudflare gateway worker; unset means no gateway connection

GATEWAY_URL.description: the Cloudflare gateway worker's URL a company's relay and the web app's public-API caller reach it through; unset means no gateway

GEMMA_GGUF_NAME.description: the filename to save the fetched Gemma GGUF model as

GEMMA_GGUF_URL.description: the URL to download the Gemma GGUF model from

GOCACHE.description: the Go build cache directory the script reads (with a /tmp fallback) and forwards to the `go build` it runs

GOMODCACHE.description: the Go module cache directory, forwarded unchanged to the `go build` tools/prepare-blueclaw-runtime runs when the caller has set one

HOME.description: the invoking user's home directory (standard POSIX variable), read to locate build caches

HOMEBREW_PREFIX.description: where Homebrew is installed, taken instead of asking `brew --prefix`; /opt/homebrew on Apple silicon, /usr/local on Intel, and anything at all in a prefix somebody chose

INTERNKIM_AGENT_BROWSER_PATH.description: path to an agent-browser binary for internal/browser's real-Chrome test, which is skipped when unset, and for internal/capabilityd/company_browser_test.go, which otherwise finds agent-browser on PATH

INTERNKIM_RIG_ARCHITECTURE.description: the architecture of the guests the install rigs boot, arm64 or amd64 (under Rosetta); defaults to arm64

INTERNKIM_API_URL.description: overrides the fleet-registration API base URL the CLI's loadConfig derives from the zone by default

INTERNKIM_APP_URL.description: where everyone signs in (https://<zone> unless the company serves the app itself); required by the relay, and handed to the host's admind from its environment file

INTERNKIM_BLUECLAW_PAYLOAD_ARTIFACT_DIR.description: where the built Blueclaw payload artifact is written; defaults under .dependency/blueclaw-payload

INTERNKIM_BLUECLAW_RUNTIME_ARTIFACT_DIR.description: where the built Blueclaw guest runtime artifact is written; defaults under .dependency/blueclaw-runtime

INTERNKIM_BLUECLAW_RUNTIME_CACHE_DIR.description: the scratch cache directory for downloaded build inputs; defaults under the scratch directory

INTERNKIM_BLUECLAW_RUNTIME_SCRATCH_DIR.description: the scratch working root for the guest runtime build; defaults under $TMPDIR

INTERNKIM_BLUECLAW_RUNTIME_WORK_DIR.description: the working directory for the guest runtime build's stage and rootfs trees; defaults under the scratch directory

INTERNKIM_BLUECLAW_USE_LOCAL.description: when "1", internal/runtime/blueclaw uses the uncommitted local .dependency/blueclaw checkout instead of the committed payload artifact

INTERNKIM_BUZZ_KEY_SEED.description: the Buzz identity seed every imported identity and channel is derived from; internal/cli reads it at setup time, tools/mirror-local writes it to the local bridge's seed file

INTERNKIM_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.description: the client id half of the internkim-cli-ssh Cloudflare Access service token, held in the operating system's vault and handed to a command by `monkeys run`; an unattended deploy and the ssh ProxyCommand authenticate with it where an operator would answer a browser login

INTERNKIM_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: the client secret half of the internkim-cli-ssh Cloudflare Access service token, held in the operating system's vault beside its client id

INTERNKIM_CONSOLE_PASSWORD.description: the console password used for a Jetson's physical login during setup/flashing; flashing writes the one it generated back here

INTERNKIM_CONTAINER_KERNEL_CACHE_DIR.description: the download cache directory for the container kernel build; defaults per-OS under XDG_CACHE_HOME or HOME

INTERNKIM_CONTAINER_KERNEL_CONFIG_REF.description: the git ref of the kernel config to build against; defaults to "main"

INTERNKIM_CONTAINER_KERNEL_DIR.description: where the built container kernel artifact is written; defaults under .dependency/container-kernel

INTERNKIM_CONTAINER_KERNEL_PAGE_SIZE.description: the page size the container kernel is built for, 4k or 16k; defaults to "4k"

INTERNKIM_CONTAINER_KERNEL_VERSION.description: the kernel version built for the Apple Container VM; defaults to 6.1.68

INTERNKIM_DEVICE_URL.description: the device's public admin address, from the @production vault profile; internal/deployops/registry.go reads it as the one deploy target

INTERNKIM_E2E_CONFIG.description: overrides the fleet run config.json path the e2e-crud/e2e-approve-button/e2e-ask-flow/reprovision-local-fleet drivers use instead of the newest one under .local/local-fleet/runs

INTERNKIM_ENVIRONMENT_FROM_VAULT.description: set by the CLI on the run it starts through `monkeys run`, so that run knows the vault environment already arrived and does not start another

INTERNKIM_FLASH_CACHE_DIR.description: override cache directory for Jetson image downloads during internal/cli's flash flow

INTERNKIM_FLEET_ID.description: the device's fleet ID, from the @production vault profile; internal/deployops/registry.go reads it as the name signed requests carry

INTERNKIM_FLEET_SECRET.description: the device's fleet secret, from the @production vault profile; internal/deployops/registry.go reads it to sign release applies and recovery requests

INTERNKIM_GATE_MODEL.description: overrides which model tools/verify-api asks a live question through, gating the paid check behind an explicit opt-in

INTERNKIM_INSTALL_HOMEBREW_TAP.description: the Homebrew tap web/static/install.sh taps before installing on macOS; defaults to this organisation's tap

INTERNKIM_INSTALL_DATABASE_VERSION_PATH.description: the PG_VERSION file web/static/install.sh reads for the PostgreSQL major the host's existing database was made by; defaults to /var/lib/internkim-postgres/PG_VERSION

INTERNKIM_INSTALL_OS_RELEASE.description: the os-release file web/static/install.sh reads for the suite of PostgreSQL's apt repository; defaults to /etc/os-release

INTERNKIM_INSTALL_POSTGRESQL_KEY_URL.description: where web/static/install.sh fetches PostgreSQL's apt signing key, which it checks against the published fingerprint; defaults to postgresql.org

INTERNKIM_INSTALL_RELEASE_URL.description: where web/static/install.sh downloads the host's files and their SHA256SUMS from; defaults to the GitHub release the channel names. The native install rig points it at a release served from the Mac

INTERNKIM_INSTALL_CHANNEL.description: the channel web/static/install.sh installs the company host from, the same as --channel: stable, the latest GitHub release, or testing, the newest release prerelease or not; defaults to stable

INTERNKIM_JETSON_IMAGE_URL.description: override URL for the Jetson base image internal/cli/jetson_flash.go downloads

INTERNKIM_KEEP_CONTAINER_VM.description: when "1", leaves the container-based runtime builder VM running after the build instead of stopping it

INTERNKIM_LITERT_MODEL_PATH.description: override path to the local LiteRT model file, read by internal/cli/main.go

INTERNKIM_LIVE_ARTIFACT_DIR.description: the directory internal/llmbackend's live OpenRouter truncation test writes its request and response evidence into; the test skips when it is unset

INTERNKIM_LIVE_LLM_TEST.description: when "1", internal/llmbackend/openrouter_live_test.go makes a real OpenRouter call instead of skipping

INTERNKIM_LLM_DEBUG.description: when "1", internal/cli/llm.go prints extra debug output for a model call

INTERNKIM_MM_ADMIN_PASSWORD_PATH.description: path to the local Mattermost admin password file, passed to admind's -mattermost-admin-password flag

INTERNKIM_REAL_CHROME_BROWSER_TEST.description: when "1", internal/browser/runtime_test.go launches a real Chrome instead of skipping

INTERNKIM_REGISTER_SECRET.description: the shared secret a device presents to the fleet registration API (the older device-fleet path's Cloudflare Pages KV binding, web/src/routes/api/fleet and api/register)

INTERNKIM_RELEASE_DOWNLOAD_TOKEN.description: the bearer token required to download a published OTA release, read by internal/cli's release-publish and setup flows; the same value is the release-registry Worker's RELEASE_DOWNLOAD_TOKEN secret

INTERNKIM_RELEASE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: the public base URL published releases are served from

INTERNKIM_RELEASE_R2_BUCKET.description: the R2 bucket releases are uploaded to

INTERNKIM_RELEASE_WRANGLER_BIN.description: override path to the wrangler binary used for PUBLISHER=wrangler release uploads

INTERNKIM_RUNTIME_BUILDER_MAX_TRANSFER_B.description: the transfer size ceiling for the remote runtime-builder rsync; defaults to 5000000000

INTERNKIM_RUNTIME_BUILDER_PROBE_SECONDS.description: how long the remote runtime-builder waits when probing the transfer; defaults to 120

INTERNKIM_SKIP_PAGES_DEPLOY_FOR_LAB.description: when "1", internal/cli/setup_flow.go skips the Cloudflare Pages deploy step for a lab/local-fleet run

INTERNKIM_SSH_HOSTNAME.description: the device's ssh hostname, from the @production vault profile; internal/deployops/registry.go reads it when the device is not on the local network

INTERNKIM_TEST_CDP_BROWSER.description: a Chromium-family executable internal/capabilityd/company_browser_test.go starts headless, with --password-store=basic and --use-mock-keychain, to stand in for Moli while browser_fill, browser_select, browser_press and browser_wait drive a real page; unset skips that test

INTERNKIM_TEST_MOLI.description: the moli executable internal/browser/device_browsers_test.go launches to prove a device browser serves the DevTools Protocol and stops; unset skips that test

INTERNKIM_TEST_SANDBOX.description: the directory tools/tests/test_install_script.py rewrites install(1)'s destination into, so the script's writes to /etc and /usr/share can be read without the test machine having either path touched

INTERNKIM_TOKEN.description: a personal-access-token bearer for the public API; web/tests/plane/a-company-plane.ts strips it from the sandboxed company plane's environment so a token in the caller's own shell cannot skip approval and requester identity there

KV.description: the Cloudflare Pages KV namespace binding backing the device fleet registry (web/src/routes/api/fleet, api/register)

LARGEST_FILE_BYTES.description: the largest attachment the relay holds in memory while copying it into the asset bucket; defaults to 200,000,000

LD_LIBRARY_PATH.description: the shared-library search path cmd/internkim-local-llm-runner extends with the LiteRT main library directory before launching litert_lm_main

LITERT_LM_BAZELISK_VERSION.description: the Bazelisk version used to build litert_lm_main

LITERT_LM_REMOTE_WORK_ROOT.description: the working directory on the remote host litert_lm_main is built in

LITERT_LM_VERSION.description: the litert_lm_main source version/ref to build

LLAMA_CPP_BUILD_JOBS.description: the parallel job count for the remote llama.cpp build

LLAMA_CPP_CUDA_ARCH.description: the CUDA architecture llama.cpp is built for on the Jetson

LLAMA_CPP_REMOTE_WORK_ROOT.description: the working directory on the remote host llama.cpp is built in

LLAMA_CPP_VERSION.description: the llama.cpp source version/ref to build

LOCAL_PLANE_LOCK_HOLDER.description: the process ID of the tools/with-local-plane run already holding this machine's local Supabase stack; a script or command that sees it set is already inside the lock and runs without taking it again

LOG_DIRECTORY_PATH.description: the log directory rendered into the company plane's runtime document; defaults to /var/log/internkim

MAILD_BASE_URL.description: maild's base URL the relay calls to answer mail; defaults to http://127.0.0.1:18092

MATTERMOST_IMPORT_TEST_DATABASE_URL.description: the Mattermost database internal/buzzimport's live end-to-end and mattermost-import tests read from

MATTERMOST_IMPORT_TEST_TEAM.description: the Mattermost team internal/buzzimport's live end-to-end and mattermost-import tests import

MEASURE_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: a Supabase Realtime access token host/relay/measure-broadcast-ceiling.ts uses instead of the anonymous publishable key

MEMBER_SESSION_ANSWER_TIMEOUT_MS.description: how long the native-install rig's member session waits for a result frame after asking a capability; defaults to 60000

MEMBER_SESSION_COMPANY_ID.description: the company the member session opens its gateway socket against, from tools/native_install_rig.py's planted company

MEMBER_SESSION_EMAIL.description: the member email the native-install rig signs in with through GoTrue for step 5's round trip

MEMBER_SESSION_GATEWAY_URL.description: the connection gateway URL the member session opens its websocket against

MEMBER_SESSION_MESSAGE.description: the message text the native-install rig's member session asks the company to post

MEMBER_SESSION_PASSWORD.description: the member password the native-install rig signs in with through GoTrue for step 5's round trip

MEMBER_SESSION_PROJECT_URL.description: the Supabase project URL the member session signs in against

MEMBER_SESSION_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.description: the Supabase publishable key the member session's sign-in call carries as apikey

MESSENGER_PLATFORM.description: which messenger the company runs (buzz or mattermost); the relay and the host's prepare script refuse to start without it, and the host's capabilityd and admind are handed it from its environment file

MIGRATION_DIRECTORY_PATH.description: the Blueclaw migrations directory rendered into the company plane's runtime document; defaults to /opt/blueclaw/migrations

MODEL_API_KEY_PATH.description: the path to the file holding the key the rendered model ladder names on every endpoint, so the key never lands in the runtime document; defaults to the file capabilityd is given

MODEL_ENDPOINT.description: the OpenAI-compatible endpoint the rendered model ladder reaches, for a company running its models through a gateway of its own; defaults to the ladder's own endpoint

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: the OpenRouter API key for remote model inference from tooling run on this machine; also read by internal/llmbackend's live OpenRouter test

PATH.description: the inherited executable search path, preserved after a temporary curl stub directory when testing verification scripts without network calls

PILOT_APP_URL.description: the local app the pilot runner's external harness reaches over MCP (claude-code arm)

PILOT_FLEET_CONFIG.description: the kept Local Fleet's config.json the pilot runner's bluecollar arms drive

PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL.description: the base URL web/playwright.config.ts points its browser at; defaults to http://127.0.0.1:5174

PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL.description: the browser channel (e.g. chrome) web/playwright.config.ts launches, when set

POSIX_HELPER_PATH.description: the blueclaw POSIX helper the rendered runtime document names; defaults to /usr/local/bin/blueclaw-posix-helper, which is the device path rather than the package's

RELAY_STATE_DIR.description: where the relay keeps the state it must survive a restart with, chiefly the durable queue of inbound messenger events under inbound/; defaults to /var/lib/internkim/relay

RELEASE_BUCKET.description: the R2 bucket binding the release-registry worker serves published release objects from

RELEASE_DOWNLOAD_TOKEN.description: the bearer token the release-registry worker requires on every download request

SUPABASE_AUTH_SIGNING_KEYS_PATH.description: the signing key set the Supabase CLI's local stack signs with; tools/with-local-plane writes it once to supabase/.temp/local-signing-keys.json and exports this for every command it runs, and tools/with-local-plane-test's fake CLI records it

SUPABASE_DB_URL.description: the database supabase/scripts/generate-record-surface.ts reads pg_proc from and supabase/tests/concurrency races two sessions against, both through supabase/scripts/local-database-url.ts; defaults to the local Supabase at postgresql://supabase_admin:postgres@127.0.0.1:54322/postgres

SUPABASE_EXPERIMENTAL_STACK.description: set to 1 by tools/with-local-plane's idle stop, which runs outside any checkout, so the Supabase CLI accepts its stack commands there; inside a checkout config.toml's [experimental] stack = true does the same, and tools/with-local-plane-test's fake CLI records it

SUPABASE_JWKS_URL.description: override JWKS URL the connection-gateway worker verifies member tokens against, instead of deriving it from SUPABASE_URL

SUPABASE_JWT_SIGNING_KEY.description: the private JWK the web app signs record tokens with for personal access tokens, agent sessions and the host, minted by web/scripts/issue-record-signing-key.ts and imported in the Supabase dashboard; locally the ES256 key tools/with-local-plane writes to supabase/.temp/local-signing-keys.json, which web/scripts/local-plane-signing-key.sh reads

SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.process: relay, host, web, connection-gateway worker, web scripts
SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.description: the Supabase project's publishable (anon) key; required across the relay, the host's admind, the web app and the gateway worker, and used by web/scripts' one-off ops scripts

SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY.description: the Supabase project's service-role secret key, read by the web app's server routes and by web/scripts' one-off ops scripts

SUPABASE_URL.process: relay, host, web, connection-gateway worker, web scripts
SUPABASE_URL.description: the Supabase project URL; required across the relay, the host's admind, the web app and the gateway worker, and used by web/scripts' one-off ops scripts

TMPDIR.description: the system temporary-directory override several tools/* build and verification scripts use as a scratch-directory base, with /tmp as the fallback

TZ.description: the IANA time zone name internal/admind/system_time_zone.go reads as the environment's declared zone

USER.description: the invoking user's login name, used as the default SSH user for the remote runtime-builder

VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.description: the VAPID public key injected into the page for push-notification subscription; the matching private key lives in Supabase Vault, not the environment

VIRTIOFSD_VERSION.description: the virtiofsd version fetched for the Blueclaw guest runtime; defaults to 1.10.0-1ubuntu0.1

VITE_ADMIND_TARGET.description: the admind base URL the local Vite dev server proxies to; defaults to http://127.0.0.1:18080

VITE_ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: a comma-separated list of extra hostnames the local Vite dev server accepts requests for

VITE_BUILD_TARGET.description: when "board", the client build renders the device board UI's home route instead of the central-plane app

VITE_DEV_USER_EMAIL.description: the fake signed-in user's email for the local Vite dev server's mock-data screens; defaults to kim@example.com

VITE_DEV_USER_ROLE.description: the fake signed-in user's role for the local Vite dev server's mock-data screens

VITE_MOCK_ADMIN.description: when "1", enables the local dev server's mocked admin/CRM screen instead of the Supabase-backed one

VITE_MOCK_CRM.description: when "1", enables the local dev server's mocked CRM screen instead of the Supabase-backed one

VITE_MOCK_FILES.description: when "1", enables the local dev server's mocked files screen instead of the Supabase-backed one

VITE_MOCK_MAIL.description: when "1", enables the local dev server's mocked mail screen instead of the Supabase-backed one

VITE_MOCK_MEMORY.description: when "1", enables the local dev server's mocked memory screen instead of the Supabase-backed one

VITE_MOCK_TASKS.description: when "1", enables the local dev server's mocked tasks screen (a second, distinct mock flag from VITE_MOCK_TASK) instead of the Supabase-backed one

WORKSPACE_ROOT_PATH.description: the workspace root rendered into the company plane's runtime document, and the cwd the relay opens an ACP session with; defaults to /workspace

XDG_CACHE_HOME.description: the XDG cache directory, read on Linux to locate the default container-kernel cache path
